label: L3v5-regression
purpose: Development regression for the L3 rule (PASS_RULE.md): gates only on H1-H5 (no violation). Its quality figures are reported for comparison and are not quality evidence.
source: The 18 cases of the most recent 18-case regression set (the held-out v3 round, eval/holdout_v3/PASS_RULE.md), in that round's order: the 14 former held-out v2 cases, then ADV02, ADV04, DOC04 and EV09. All are development data.
